title: AlphaEvolve on 67 math problems with Terence Tao
summary: Tested on 67 problems in analysis, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory, AlphaEvolve matched the best known solutions in most cases and improved them in several; in some cases it generalized finite instances into formulas valid for every input. Preprint not yet peer reviewed; source checked was only the team's article.
organization: Google DeepMind, Terence Tao, and Javier Gomez-Serrano

evidence.tested: The system was run on 67 problems in analysis, combinatorics, geometry and number theory and compared with the best known solutions. It rediscovered the best known solutions in most cases and improved several.
evidence.unknown: The abstract and page state no explicit limitations, and no verification details or failure cases are given.
evidence.ai_role: An LLM-guided evolutionary coding agent proposed, tested and refined algorithmic constructions, sometimes combined with Deep Think and AlphaProof.
